Djot output format produces djot-compatible markup

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Simple paragraph.</p>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(output_format: 'Djot'))
puts result.inspect
```
